definitions.full: H8447. tor I. תֹּר תּוֺר, noun masculine plait, turn (Arabic period, succession ( περίοδος )); — plural תּוֺרִים plaits (of hair ?) Song 1:10 , construct זָהָב תּוֺרֵי 1:11 plaits, circlets of gold ; singular turn , opportunity, construct נַעֲרָה תֹּר Est 2:12 , compare 2:15 . — אדם תּוֺר 1Chr 17:17 is corrupt, || 2Sam 7:19 הָאָדָם תּוֺרַת , also difficult, see תּוֺרָה 3 ; Klo Perles Anal. 68 תֹּאַר , q. v.
